subject: FY 2017 School Budget
overview: The Medford School Committee approved the FY 2017 school budget in a 5-2 vote after incorporating targeted staffing additions and heard public input. The committee also appointed Suzanne Galusi as the new principal of Brooks Elementary School, approved an athletic conference merger, and adopted a revised community school fee structure.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Financial Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 6, 2016 meeting alongside routine bills, payrolls, and fund transfers.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Report
items.summary: Accepted the Committee of the Whole report evaluating Superintendent Roy Belson for the 2015-2016 school year with an overall average rating of 3.87.

items.title: Report on Administrative Work Week
items.summary: Placed on file a report outlining administrative debriefs, initiative planning, and professional development scheduled for June 22-28.

items.title: Merger of GBL with Northeast Conference
items.summary: Approved merging the Greater Boston League athletic program with the Northeast Conference starting in spring 2017.

items.title: Community Schools Fee Structure
items.summary: Approved the updated community schools facility rental fee schedule with amendments requiring non-profit documentation and contact rosters for booster groups.

items.title: Superintendent Succession Plan Report
items.summary: Accepted a proposed superintendent succession plan outlining interim leadership protocols and a five-phase search process, referring details to the personnel subcommittee.

items.title: Recognition of Medford Kiwanis Book Donation
items.summary: Recognized City Councilor Rick Caraviello and the Medford Kiwanis Club for their annual book donation program supporting first and third grade students.

items.title: Summer Operating Rules and Delegated Authority
items.summary: Approved delegating operational authority to the superintendent and secretary through the summer recess, with an added requirement for a mid-summer report in early August.

items.title: Resolutions and Moment of Silence
items.summary: Adopted resolutions expressing condolences to the victims of the Orlando shooting and the family of local business leader Robert Sorabian.

items.title: Appointment of Brooks Elementary School Principal
items.summary: Announced the appointment of Assistant Principal Suzanne Galusi as the principal of Brooks Elementary School, effective July 1, 2016.

items.title: FY 2017 School Budget Public Hearing and Vote
items.summary: Approved the FY 2017 school budget in a 5-2 vote following additions for full-time kindergarten aides at the Roberts School, a middle school librarian, a math coach, and a behavior specialist. The committee also voted to declare surplus musical equipment for sale into a fine arts gift account.
